prose: The Wall Street Journal report, as summarized by Techmeme, says United will prevent unauthorized personal AI assistants from booking tickets because of privacy risks and possible aviation-rule conflicts. The original article was not retrievable, so exact exceptions and implementation details cannot be established from this item.
highlights: United restriction reported by the Journal
Privacy and aviation compliance are stated reasons
Original policy detail was not accessible
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; original article fetch failed.
